scenario: A buyer has a hard $60 budget and wants one portable speaker for a balcony and occasional poolside use. They distrust headline wattage and distortion-free marketing.
target: Audit the physical meaning and evidence limits of the listed wattage, distortion, 360-degree, passive-radiator, IPX7, battery, and hi-res-over-Bluetooth claims, then choose the better-supported route under the stated priorities.
